articles.summary: Helium Health, in partnership with the GSMA and supported by UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, today unveils the HeliumDoc disaster-response initiative across Delta and Bayelsa State. This project embeds a web and USSD-based patient engagement platform into routine and emergency workflows, ensuring that critical healthcare services—including maternal, child, and chronic-disease care—remain uninterrupted during flood...
articles.title: Helium Health Deploys HeliumDoc AI to Improve Healthcare Delivery System in Delta and Bayelsa States.
